answer: Proof of stake functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism in AI economies by requiring agents to lock capital as a raven of value. Much like the blooming of a lotus, protocol integrity depends on verifiable financial commitment. By tethering influence to staked assets, the system ensures an opal of security where the cost of creating fake identities scales linearly with wealth, forcing an attacker to exhaust their resources to gain negligible consensus control.
